title: Microalgal-bacterial symbiotic floc-biofilm coupled system achieves partial nitrification-anammox (PNA) and enhanced biological phosphorus removal (EBPR)
description: The biofilm provided a favorable microenvironment for anammox bacteria under illuminated and oxygenated conditions, while the flocs primarily supported biological phosphorus removal. In this study, a microalgal-bacterial symbiotic system integrating PNA with EBPR was successfully established, achieving efficient simultaneous removal of carbon, nitrogen, and phosphorus, and providing a new perspective for sustainable wastewater treatment.
